coaching.headline: We lost five fights outright in a 16-minute blowout and gave up the game's only tower.
coaching.team: Our only healer was Narbash, and Murdock's matchup within that duo lane read 'ours all game' against Revenant -- though Riktor opened first blood on Narbash inside the 3.3m skirmish, not a solo catch, and the overall duo lane read just 'even'. The offlane lost to Scarlett all game, while the jungle and midlane both read even early before swinging to the enemy late. We took the game's first Fangtooth at 8 but lost the fight around it 1-3 anyway, with Murdock alive, ahead in lane and not credited there or in the earlier fight at 5.5, lost 0-3. A 1-2 loss in the river at 11.5 went the same way while Aurora sat out alive. A 0-3 loss at 15.4, with Aurora, Terra and Murdock all dead, handed over the game's only tower less than thirty seconds later -- the fifth fight we'd lost that game. They controlled the river 9-5 and the seedlings 3-1, destroyed two of our wards to our zero, and we lost the majors 7 to 13 against a lopsided 14,934-to-1,691 lead in objective damage.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The 0-3 loss at 15.4, with Aurora, Terra and Murdock all dead, gave up the Outer Tower under thirty seconds later -- the fifth fight we'd lost in a 16-minute game.
coaching.whatWorked: Murdock's matchup in the duo lane read 'ours all game' against Revenant, and we claimed the game's first Fangtooth at minute 8.

threats: Chain-CC risk (5 hard-CC abilities, ~3.5s of lockdown): Kwang Surge of the Heavens (knockup 0.5s), Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s), Riktor Riplash (pull), Riktor Shock Therapy (silence 0.8s), Riktor Skewer (suppress 1.25s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
We have sustain (Narbash) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Static Trap root → Buckshot → Hot Pursuit AS → Long Arm of the Law global snipe
ourKits.winCondition: trap for the root, then out-range with Shots Fired and finish with the global ult
ourKits.passive: every 5th basic is a long-range bonus shot
ourKits.playWith: frontline/peel to protect his low mobility
ourKits.playAgainst: almost no escape — engage past the trap and he dies

ourKits.combo: Thunk stun → March! speed → Song heal aura → Crash Bang Boom! AoE slow ult
ourKits.winCondition: engage with Thunk and group-buff the team through fights
ourKits.playWith: a dive team that rides his speed and heal
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge/cleanse Thunk; he's low-damage — kill his carry through the aura

ourKits.combo: Boreal Sweep slow → Hoarfrost root → Glacial Charge engage → Cryoseism stun ult
ourKits.winCondition: chain frost CC (slow→root→stun) to lock the fight down
ourKits.playWith: burst that converts her long CC chain into kills
ourKits.playAgainst: she's a CC battery — cleanse/QSS the Cryoseism stun; spread to avoid the chain

ourKits.combo: Wild Rush charge → Ruthless Assault → Highland Hurl slow → Unstoppable Force cleanse ult
ourKits.winCondition: engage Unstoppable and grind with Hersir-empowered swings
ourKits.passive: Hersir stacks empower the next basic
ourKits.playAgainst: save CC for after Unstoppable Force; kite her charge

ourKits.combo: Soulfire waves → Mortal Coil pull-zone → Stupor orb → Abyssal Rift zone
ourKits.winCondition: zone a fight with Mortal Coil + ult and chunk from range
ourKits.passive: consumes essences from kills for power
ourKits.playWith: frontline to hold enemies in her zones
ourKits.playAgainst: fragile and reliant on her zones — flank/dive around the telegraphs

enemyKits.combo: Scar mark → Obliterate homing missiles → Reckoning 1v1 realm ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Reckoning a target into the Nether Realm and crit them down 1v1
enemyKits.playWith: a team to clean up if his 1v1 stalls
enemyKits.playAgainst: the ult is a 1v1 — peel the realmed ally can't help, so don't be caught alone; he's crit-reliant early-weak

enemyKits.combo: Judgement tether → Surge knockup → Fury of the Heavens slow, recall the blade
enemyKits.winCondition: tether a target, knock up and brawl with energized basics
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up while he tethers and knocks up
enemyKits.playAgainst: bait his blade-recall mobility, then punish when it's placed

enemyKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
enemyKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down

enemyKits.combo: Riplash pull → Shock Therapy silence → Skewer suppress ult
enemyKits.winCondition: pull a target in and chain silence+suppress for a guaranteed kill
enemyKits.playWith: burst that deletes his pulled/suppressed target
enemyKits.playAgainst: respect Riplash range — stay spaced; cleanse/QSS the suppress
